description:
Makes one change through the Chain Daddy REST API, documented at https://docs.chaindaddy.io/api-reference/explorer (OpenAPI: https://docs.chaindaddy.io/openapi.yaml), by the operation's tool name and arguments: for example editing a token page, an alert rule or a holder group, or sending holders a message. Acts as the signed-in user and needs Sign in with Chain Daddy allowing changes (scope api:write). Some changes notify people or cannot be undone. It does not pay, mint, launch, claim or trade.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy, allowing changes (scope api:write).

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, matching its input schema. Omit or {} when it takes none.

tool.description: The changing operation's tool name, as the operation search lists it.

name: call_write_operation
title: Run a change
